events.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Rosa: I’ll be here this afternoon to log the repair drive supplies, and Cleo can drop off the screws and tape with me then. That’ll help us keep everything organized.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll bring my work gloves and hammer by this afternoon.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rosa: Perfect, Rey — I’ll note your gloves and hammer when you get here this afternoon.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Eli: I’ll make a quick list for Gus and send it over. He can just bring whatever tools he already has.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rey: I’ve got work gloves and a hammer I can bring. Let me know if you hear anything else about the drive.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey—that helps a lot. I’ll send Gus the list and let you know if anything else comes up.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rey: It’s happening here right now, so I brought my work gloves and a hammer. I’ll keep in touch with Ira in case I hear anything else.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — I can help around school drop-off or pickup if that makes it easier. Keep me posted if the schedule changes.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll let you know if anything shifts. Thanks for being ready to help around school drop-off or pickup.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: It’s here now, so I’m bringing my work gloves and hammer. If you hear anything, let me know.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the drop-off window and pass along anything Leo sends. Once I get the updated details, I’ll help with the repair drive.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah. I’ll be ready here with my gloves and hammer when it’s time.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: Gus is bringing the tools over on Saturday to get things moving. Bo’s also bringing a few hand tools and gloves, and Gus set aside a hammer and some screwdrivers for Noah.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: Good to know — I’ve got work gloves and a hammer ready too. If you hear anything else about the drive, let me know.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: Will do — I’m just passing along what I hear, so I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll check the sign-up sheet first before I do anything. And it’s good to know Jules will keep both groups updated about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Rey: I’ve got my work gloves and hammer ready. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Hana: Perfect, thanks Rey. I’ll keep an eye on the sign-up sheet and wait for your update.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Oren: Great, thanks Rey — I’ll sort the donations and help load a few boxes when the repair drive starts.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’ve got my work gloves and hammer ready for the repair drive here.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Oren: Perfect, that’ll help a lot. I’m a little forgetful, but I’ll stick to sorting the donations and loading boxes for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Opal: Gus is bringing the hammer and screwdrivers, and Dane and Mara are helping spread the word. Jules is sharing the details with both friend groups and encouraging everyone to come by.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Rey: That’s great — I’ve got my work gloves and a hammer ready too. I’ll let Ira know to pass along anything they hear.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Opal: Perfect — with your gloves and hammer, we’re set. If Ira hears anything else, send it my way and I’ll keep track.
events.speaker: Opal
